item.title: My thoughts on Heated Rivalry, what it says about today’s society, and what lessons we can take from it
item.description: Along with basically everyone else , I watched the original series Heated Rivalry, released on the Canadian network Crave and HBO Max in the US, over winter break, three times to be exact. Yes, it’s raunchy, and the bed takes up a large part of the setting, but it is really a love story- the one that we need in the social and political times we are living in today.
